decisions.rationale: Chronic pain management via nonpharmacologic/integrative approaches is NCCIH's top strategic research priority.
NIDCR funds oral/oropharyngeal cancer, craniofacial, salivary and swallowing research within head and neck scope.
AI/AN health is a specific minority-population focus within health equity/disparities research.
Biotechnology and biomedical engineering share engineered biological systems, devices and platforms.
CBD research is largely therapeutic pharmacology, parallel to Therapeutic Cannabinoid match.
Oral and craniofacial conditions, incl. oral cancers, overlap head and neck medicine.
Down syndrome is a neurodevelopmental condition central to pediatric research, like Rett.
Fragile X is a pediatric neurodevelopmental genetic disorder.
Neuroblastoma is a pediatric cancer; Pediatric Cancer already maps area_broader here.
Unintentional childhood injury is a subset of Childhood Injury, mapped to pediatrics.
Orphan drug research is therapeutic development for rare diseases.
Tobacco smoking health effects overlap tobacco use research, consistent with Tobacco mapping.
Tuberous sclerosis is a neurocutaneous disorder (epilepsy), like Neurofibromatosis mapped here.
Ataxia telangiectasia is a progressive cerebellar neurodegenerative disorder.
Estrogen research centers on hormonal regulation, core endocrine scope.
